notes.title: Patch Notes #3: Additional Camera Settings
notes.content:
Hey, adventurers!

We have released a new patch that adds additional camera settings as well as other improvements! 

Here are the patch notes:
[list]
[*] Additional "Camera Zoom Distance" options.
[*] Any progress-based Steam Achievements missed (such as "Blood of Mercy") will be retroactively applied.
[*] Fixed issue where Valentine could be invulnerable on some optional levels.
[*] Hot Keys improvements.
[*] Video Options improvements.
[*] Localization updates.
[*] Hordes of Mercy UI updates.
[*] Misc bug fixes and stability improvements.
[/list]
-Riv Otter

notes.title: Hotkeys and Expanded Audio Settings Patch!
notes.content:
Hey, adventurers!

I’ve got more news for [i]Absolute Tactics: Daughters of Mercy[/i]. We heard you, and Patch 1.28 is now live which includes hotkeys and expanded audio settings!

Here are the patch notes:
[list]
[*] Hot Keys! Hero actions are now mapped to 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 for Move, Attack, Skills, Items, Wait. They can be rebounded to other keys.
[*] More Audio Options! You can now adjust Music, Sound Effects, Voice and UI volumes independently.
[*] Fixed some issues with Hordes of Mercy mode Kill Counts and Rewards.
[*] Adjusting the way the "Blood of Mercy" achievement is awarded.
[*] Adjusting presentation of hero pathing arrows for easier visibility.
[*] Fixing bugs where enemy movement range wouldn't display properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where Valentine could be invulnerable on the optional Bone River level.
[*] Lots of miscellaneous small bug fixes and some situational crash fixes.
[/list]
-Riv Otter

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey adventurers!

We are still hard at work on the next patch for [i]Absolute Tactics: Daughters of Mercy[/i]. Steam trading cards are now available for Absolute Tactics! There are now 8 collectible trading cards available that players should immediately receive and future players can receive by playing the game! If you would like to trade with other adventurers to complete your collection of loot, head over to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1636660/tradingforum/]Steam Forums[/url] and negotiate trades!

- [AG] Riv Otter

notes.title: Graphical Setting Patch!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers! 

Thanks all for your support of Absolute Tactics: Daughters of Mercy. I’m happy to announce, with the feedback you have given us, a patch that adds graphical settings! This patch is live right now!

Here is a patch log of the changes.

[list]
[*] Added Frame Rate Cap Options
[*] Added Windowed and Fullscreen Options
[*] Added Screen Resolution Options
[*] Added Vsync Option
[*] Fixed issue in Optional Needlehorn Village where Bow of Mercy unit was inactive
[*] Other small bugs
[/list]
We’re still hard at work with Absolute Tactics and coming soon we are implementing action hotkeys!

-Riv Otter
